messages:
emily: Ran into a weird one — our sample app in the monorepo fails only when run in the edge dev server and core-lib is a pnpm workspace symlink. stack traces point to consumer dist paths.
emily: repro: pnpm -w install && pnpm -w build && pnpm --filter sample dev:edge
emily: runtime: Error: Cannot find module 'core-lib/esm'
sam: ugh same class of bug. usually exports + symlink resolution. bundler calls realpath and ends up resolving into the consumer tree which makes esbuild pick up wrong entry.
hugo: Checklist: 1) validate package.json exports has both import/require and "./package.json" mapped, 2) ensure dist contains typings and sourcesContent in sourcemap, 3) turn off declarationMap for in-repo packages.
hugo: snippet we use in package.json exports: { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }
maya: Workarounds: import from file:../packages/core-lib/dist/esm in the sample for local edge dev, or set pnpm nodeLinker=node-modules to avoid symlinks. Not great but helpful for quick testing.
leo: CI noticed it too — dev-bot reported apps/sample-edge startup failure (job 412). attaching small log in the issue.
dev-bot: CI failure: apps/sample-edge 7 startup 7 Cannot find module 'core-lib/esm' (job 412)
sam: For the dev server plugin, we can detect workspace symlinks and prefer resolving to the package root dist. quick patch: if (isWorkspaceSymlink(id)) resolve(join(workspaceRoot, pkgDir, 'dist/esm/index.js')) — hacky but effective until upstream fix.
emily: I'll add a README entry documenting node version compat (18 vs 20), the pnpm linker difference, and the temp import-from-dist workaround. filing an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/241 (draft)
hugo: long-term we should change the resolver to avoid fs.realpath for workspace packages and make sourcemap emission use sourceRoot or sourcesContent so edge tracebacks map to package src. thanks all :+1:
